First Foundation Advisors decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 17.61% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. First Foundation Advisors sold 20,358 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 95,229 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.12M, down from 115,587 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Foundation Advisors who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.90B market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $188.58. About 15.45M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 28, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
